root.rule: No code, key, table, or column carries the display name as the root identifier; display binds at serving tier only (R-1).

axis1.intent: partition client-advised assets (AUA) by composition -- one axis, one intent
axis1.grain_note: Account-level tests are mapping rules onto position grain, never a second grain.

values.definition: any client assets invested in an Opal Model (a multi-constituent allocation), Archetypal (UST/ST/INT/LT/ULT) or Custom (e.g. Opal-constituent models on Cottonwood BD)
positions in accounts devoted ENTIRELY to one Opal Strategy: ETF-replica (PFOE, DIVZ -- 49F, SmartX), Tax SMA, Muni SMA
values.layering_rejected: Andrew-direct R-2: 'I wouldn't try to break these into two different layers.'

values.definition: insurance assets (BD carries an insurance endpoint; Cottonwood and 49F believed to hold insurance client data)
values.cannot_move_until: read-only BD insurance endpoint discovery pass

values.authority: Andrew-direct R-3: establish the rails now even if the names change

values.definition: non-discretionary advisory assets -- Non-Model but Fee-Paying. THE EXPLICIT RESIDUAL: AUA not classified into values 1-4. Computed LAST, by construction.
positions the classifier could not place. NOT a business value -- a loud error bucket.

discriminator.sma_account_test: account devoted ENTIRELY to one Opal Strategy (all-or-nothing); a mixed account can never be SMAS, so no position is claimed twice

controls.naming_convention_fragility: names FEED the classifier ('Opal' token, is_opal_name substring test) but never close it: a naming miss surfaces as reconcile break + UNCLASSIFIED residue, never a silent undercount
controls.join_discipline: ids, never names (measured hazard: BD strategy name with leading space, ' Anna *9238')

axis2.intent: Opal ETF product AUM -- separate axis, fund grain

values.definition: ETF assets held in client accounts (classified on axis1)
the balance of Opal public ETFs NOT held with an Opal client
values.open_defect_flag: leg ordering (holdings 16:00Z before fund totals 22:00Z) INFERRED-not-reverified; day-alignment rule DECIDED at implementation under ETFS CANON

strategy_id_registry.rule: every classified position carries a stable strategy_id independent of its bucket label

clocks.as_of: PROVENANCE clock -- the day whose membership the row reflects
clocks.computed_at: WRITE clock -- when the row was produced

vintage.clock_rule: any gate or consumer of the classification declares WHICH clock it reads (foundation-ledger two-clock law)

point_in_time.scope: the Cottonwood AUA question as asked; estate-wide reading requires its own Andrew ruling
point_in_time.restatement: NOT_FORECLOSED_NOT_BUILT (mapping-row design makes a future restatement a re-join)

rollup.rule: one classifier; per-firm artifacts (49F, Inflection, Cottonwood); GLOBAL = sum of firm partitions; reconcile control inherited at both grains
rollup.known_hazard: Cottonwood BD fact_holdings is RELATIONSHIP grain (Relationship x Account x Asset) -- collapse via collapse_relationship_grain() before any sum
